statement: When the target is existence of some witness, type whether a route fixes one representative/source component or ranges over a complete source family. A fixed-witness failure may not be promoted to existential source-family failure without a DifferenceWitness-compatible completeness bridge. Track component/higher-order compatibility separately as gluing.
preconditions: research target contains witness/source existential quantifiers
route uses deformation of a selected representative or source component
negative route inference could affect routing
falsifier: Show that the problem contract canonically fixes the representative, or prove a theorem making the selected source complete for all admissible witnesses in the exact category.
non_authority: One Hodge-lane episode does not authorize a ResearchTool, method change, or cross-domain promotion.
